# TelamonJS

> TelamonJS — the admin framework that holds your systems up

Generated by `pnpm docs:generate` — do not edit by hand.

## Packages

- [@telamonjs/ui](packages/ui/README.md): Admin framework for Next.js + React: declarative CRUD (CrudConfig + TanStack Query), 36-type field system, rich dialogs, app shell, dashboards and charts
- [@telamonjs/data](packages/data/README.md): The server half of a TelamonJS list: the ListPage wire contract, sort and paging sanitizers, and a Prisma adapter (orderBy, scope-safe where, paginated services). Zero dependencies
- [@telamonjs/auth](packages/auth/README.md): NextAuth v5 <-> NestJS auth bridge: the JWE session-token contract, a Nest guard, Next callbacks and revocable impersonation
- [@telamonjs/permissions](packages/permissions/README.md): RBAC materialized into the JWT: client-safe permission checker, role helpers, a NestJS guard/decorator and a reference Prisma schema
- [@telamonjs/logger](packages/logger/README.md): Structured logging with one ILogger across browser, server and worker: audit and perf extensions, child loggers, request IDs and timers
- [@telamonjs/queue](packages/queue/README.md): BullMQ job engine: config-driven jobs stored in Redis, workers, dead-letter queues, Bull Board dashboard, Prometheus metrics and an HTTP/NestJS backend for queue dashboards
- [@telamonjs/cli](packages/cli/README.md): commands — CLI for TelamonJS: create a Next.js admin app (single app or monorepo), generate CRUD modules from a Prisma schema, lint admin modules and manage database dumps

## API

- [Public API index](docs/exports.md): every entry point of every package, runtime names and types
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to work in this repository (commands, evidence rule, traps)

## Core Concepts

- [Patterns](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/index.mdx): The architectural patterns behind a TelamonJS app - CRUD modules, forms, dialogs, detail pages and the app shell
- [CrudConfig](apps/docs/content/docs/getting-started/crud-config.mdx): The central concept of TelamonJS — one object that drives an entire CRUD module
- [Module Structure](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/admin-module-structure.mdx): The files of a CRUD admin module, what goes in config.tsx, and how data flows from the list to the database
- [Data Layer (React Query)](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/react-query.mdx): API client, query, mutations and cache invalidation behind every CrudConfig module
- [ListPage Pattern](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/listpage-pattern.mdx): Config-driven list pages with React Query, infinite scroll or pagination, search, filters and row actions
- [Dialogs](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/dialogs.mdx): Create, edit and view dialogs declared in CrudConfig.dialogs — rich headers, tabs, deep links, portal views, and the standalone components
- [Form Pattern](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/form-pattern.mdx): The form components and when to use each - from simple CRUD to multi-step flows
- [Detail Views](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/detail-page.mdx): Read-only views of one record, in the view dialog by default or on a dedicated page, built from the Detail components
- [Provider Setup Pattern](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/provider-setup.mdx): Correct provider hierarchy for TelamonJS apps (AdminShell + React Query)
- [Theming & Dark Mode](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/theming.mdx): The CSS-variable tokens the shell, tabs and charts paint with, how dark mode switches them, and the ThemeToggle
- [Internationalization (i18n)](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/i18n.mdx): Multi-language UI text with next-intl — msg() in configs, locale per user, formatting and zod messages

## Guides

- [Nested Data Pattern](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/nested-data.mdx): Handle nested data with React Hook Form + Zod - keep nested throughout
- [CRUD Field Pattern](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/crud-field.mdx): Manage nested 1:N and N:M relationships directly inside the parent form
- [Dashboard Pattern](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/dashboard.mdx): Viewport-filling dashboards with auto-refresh, fullscreen, and stat cards
- [Standalone form pages](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/edit-page.mdx): When a module needs dedicated create/edit routes — EditPage and CreatePage with shared form sections, Zod validation and typed actions
- [Performance](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/performance.mdx): React and Next.js performance rules for TelamonJS apps — bundle, request waterfalls, re-renders and rendering
- [Accessibility & Testing](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/accessibility.mdx): Semantic test IDs, aria labels, and loading states across the framework

## Components

- [Components](apps/docs/content/docs/components/index.mdx): Every component of @telamonjs/ui, grouped as in the sidebar
- [AdminShell](apps/docs/content/docs/components/admin-shell.mdx): Canonical app shell — ModernSidebar + Cmd+K CommandPalette + ResponsiveBreadcrumb
- [AppShell](apps/docs/content/docs/components/app-shell.mdx): Flexible application layout with multiple variants
- [ModernSidebar](apps/docs/content/docs/components/modern-sidebar.mdx): Modern hierarchical sidebar — compact/expanded, mobile drawer, string-based icons
- [CommandPalette](apps/docs/content/docs/components/command-palette.mdx): Keyboard-driven command palette (Cmd+K) for quick navigation and actions
- [Breadcrumb](apps/docs/content/docs/components/breadcrumbs.mdx): Breadcrumb primitives, plus the route-aware breadcrumbs used by the admin shell
- [Tabs](apps/docs/content/docs/components/tabs.mdx): Tab navigation component for switching between related views
- [ShellPage](apps/docs/content/docs/components/shell-page.mdx): Full-height composable page container with CSS fullscreen support
- [AdminHeader](apps/docs/content/docs/components/admin-header.mdx): Pure header bar with title, icon, description, status, and fullscreen toggle
- [AdminTabs](apps/docs/content/docs/components/admin-tabs.mdx): ContentTabs wrapper with height-filling CSS for shell page layouts
- [TabToolbar](apps/docs/content/docs/components/tab-toolbar.mdx): Composable compound toolbar for filters, search, and actions inside tab panels
- [ListPage](apps/docs/content/docs/components/list-page.mdx): Complete list page rendered from a single CrudConfig — search, sort, pagination, dialogs
- [DataTable](apps/docs/content/docs/components/data-table.mdx): Advanced data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, and row selection
- [ReportTable](apps/docs/content/docs/components/report-table.mdx): Read-only table with progressive "load more" pagination for reports and dashboards
- [MobileCard](apps/docs/content/docs/components/mobile-card.mdx): Card component for mobile-responsive data display in tables
- [ConfirmActionDialog](apps/docs/content/docs/components/confirm-action-dialog.mdx): Confirmation dialog for an async action, with validated inputs, free content, a dialog- or caller-controlled pending state and inline errors
- [QueryErrorState](apps/docs/content/docs/components/query-error-state.mdx): Error state of a query with a localized title, the error's message and a "Try again" button that stays pending while it retries
- [CreatePage](apps/docs/content/docs/components/create-page.mdx): Page wrapper for create forms with consistent layout
- [EditPage](apps/docs/content/docs/components/edit-page.mdx): Complete page wrapper for edit forms with tabs support
- [BaseFormPage](apps/docs/content/docs/components/base-form-page.mdx): DRY wrapper for form pages with conditional PageContent wrapping
- [Form Component](apps/docs/content/docs/components/form.mdx): Declarative form component with built-in Zod validation
- [CreateForm](apps/docs/content/docs/components/create-form.mdx): Semantic wrapper for creation forms with automatic editOnly filtering
- [RichSelector](apps/docs/content/docs/components/rich-selector.mdx): Searchable selector with a title and a detail line per option, server search, multiple selection and a form adapter
- [EditForm](apps/docs/content/docs/components/edit-form.mdx): Semantic wrapper for edit forms with required id and data props
- [ZustandForm](apps/docs/content/docs/components/zustand-form.mdx): Form with Zustand state management for wizards and complex forms
- [DetailLayout](apps/docs/content/docs/components/detail-layout.mdx): Base layout for detail/view pages with alerts, header actions and responsive columns
- [DetailCard](apps/docs/content/docs/components/detail-card.mdx): Card component for grouping related information in detail pages
- [DetailCardHeader](apps/docs/content/docs/components/detail-card-header.mdx): Reusable card header component with icon, badge, and actions
- [DetailField](apps/docs/content/docs/components/detail-field.mdx): Display label-value pairs with optional icons
- [DetailStatsGrid](apps/docs/content/docs/components/detail-stats-grid.mdx): Grid of metric cards for displaying statistics
- [DetailStatus](apps/docs/content/docs/components/detail-status.mdx): Status badge component for displaying entity states
- [DetailAlert](apps/docs/content/docs/components/detail-alert.mdx): Alert component for displaying contextual messages in detail pages
- [DetailAvatar](apps/docs/content/docs/components/detail-avatar.mdx): Avatar component with fallback initials and zoomable preview
- [DetailActions](apps/docs/content/docs/components/detail-actions.mdx): Action buttons card for detail pages with common operations
- [DashboardGrid](apps/docs/content/docs/components/dashboard-grid.mdx): Drag-and-drop dashboard layout for widgets, powered by react-grid-layout
- [ChartWidget](apps/docs/content/docs/components/chart-widget.mdx): Dashboard widget that renders a line, bar, or pie chart in a card
- [StatCard](apps/docs/content/docs/components/stats-card.mdx): Card for one dashboard metric — label, value, icon and color, with an optional animated count
- [KPICard](apps/docs/content/docs/components/kpi-card.mdx): Key Performance Indicator card with trend visualization
- [LineChart](apps/docs/content/docs/components/line-chart.mdx): Line chart component for visualizing trends over time
- [BarChart](apps/docs/content/docs/components/bar-chart.mdx): Bar chart component for comparing values across categories
- [AreaChart](apps/docs/content/docs/components/area-chart.mdx): Area chart component for cumulative trends and stacked volumes
- [PieChart](apps/docs/content/docs/components/pie-chart.mdx): Pie chart component for showing part-to-whole relationships
- [Timeline](apps/docs/content/docs/components/timeline.mdx): Timeline component for displaying chronological events and activities
- [KanbanBoard](apps/docs/content/docs/components/kanban-board.mdx): Drag-and-drop kanban board for visual workflow management
- [Calendar](apps/docs/content/docs/components/calendar.mdx): Interactive calendar component for date selection and event display
- [ComparisonTable](apps/docs/content/docs/components/comparison-table.mdx): Feature comparison table for plans or products, with check/cross cells and grouped rows
- [ProgressTracker](apps/docs/content/docs/components/progress-tracker.mdx): Visual progress indicator with multiple steps and status
- [DropdownMenu](apps/docs/content/docs/components/dropdown-menu.mdx): Dropdown menu component for actions and options
- [QuickActionCard / QuickActionGrid](apps/docs/content/docs/components/quick-actions.mdx): Shortcut cards for frequent dashboard actions
- [ExportButtons](apps/docs/content/docs/components/export-button.mdx): Export dropdown and buttons for CSV, Excel, and PDF downloads
- [BaseCard](apps/docs/content/docs/components/base-card.mdx): Foundation card component for consistent UI building blocks
- [LoadingSkeleton](apps/docs/content/docs/components/loading-skeleton.mdx): Unified loading skeleton with multiple shapes
- [StatusBadge](apps/docs/content/docs/components/status-badge.mdx): Reusable status badge with typed variants (new, beta, status, trend, custom)

## Hooks

- [Hooks](apps/docs/content/docs/hooks/index.mdx): React hooks exported by the UI package, grouped by what they do
- [useTableState](apps/docs/content/docs/hooks/use-table-state.mdx): Read the state of a DataTable or ListPage from the shared table store
- [useUrlSync](apps/docs/content/docs/hooks/use-url-sync.mdx): Sync state with URL query params in the Next.js App Router
- [useTabUrlSync](apps/docs/content/docs/hooks/use-tab-url-sync.mdx): URL-driven tab state with deep-linking and browser history
- [useUrlFilters](apps/docs/content/docs/hooks/use-url-filters.mdx): A URL-driven "Filters" panel for ListPage — selectors, date ranges and text, shareable by link
- [useShellPage](apps/docs/content/docs/hooks/use-shell-page.mdx): Access ShellPage fullscreen context from any descendant
- [useAnimatedCounter](apps/docs/content/docs/hooks/use-animated-counter.mdx): Animate number transitions with easing at 60 FPS

## Backend Packages

- [Data](apps/docs/content/docs/packages/data.mdx): The server half of a list — the ListPage wire contract, sort and paging sanitizers, and a Prisma adapter with scope-safe where and paginated services
- [Auth](apps/docs/content/docs/packages/auth.mdx): Auth bridge NextAuth v5 ↔ NestJS — shared session-token contract, Nest guard, Next callbacks
- [Permissions](apps/docs/content/docs/packages/permissions.mdx): RBAC materialized in the JWT — pure checkers, role helpers, Nest guard and Prisma models
- [Logger](apps/docs/content/docs/packages/logger.mdx): Structured logging for TelamonJS — one ILogger interface for browser, server and workers, with child loggers, timers, audit and perf extensions
- [Queue](apps/docs/content/docs/queue/index.mdx): Production-ready background job system for TelamonJS — BullMQ, Redis, type-safe jobs, scheduling, DLQ and monitoring

## Reference

- [Field Types](apps/docs/content/docs/reference/field-types.mdx): All 36 field types registered in the telamonjs-ui field system
- [Decision Trees](apps/docs/content/docs/reference.mdx): Which page, form, detail component, layout, chart or field type fits your case
- [Troubleshooting](apps/docs/content/docs/troubleshooting.mdx): Two copies of a peer dependency, "No QueryClient set", consuming the packages via link:, NestJS guard exceptions across package instances, and the Zustand getSnapshot loop
- [Zustand Selector Pattern](apps/docs/content/docs/patterns/zustand-selector.mdx): Avoid infinite loops - the getSnapshot should be cached warning

## Other pages

- [Bulk Operations](apps/docs/content/docs/queue/bulk-operations.mdx): Efficiently add, remove, retry, clean and drain many jobs at once
- [Dashboard](apps/docs/content/docs/queue/dashboard.mdx): The Jobs Dashboard — real-time queue monitoring UI from @telamonjs/ui/queue, plus the embeddable Bull Board server
- [Dead Letter Queue](apps/docs/content/docs/queue/dead-letter-queue.mdx): Inspect, analyze and manually retry jobs that permanently failed after exhausting retries
- [Error Handling](apps/docs/content/docs/queue/error-handling.mdx): Structured error classes with categorized codes, context data and classification utilities
- [Logging](apps/docs/content/docs/queue/logging.mdx): Structured logging via ILogger injection from @telamonjs/logger
- [Metrics](apps/docs/content/docs/queue/metrics.mdx): Prometheus metrics with caching, batching and sampling for high-throughput queues
- [Priorities](apps/docs/content/docs/queue/priorities.mdx): Semantic job priority levels and utilities for ordering queue processing
- [Scheduling](apps/docs/content/docs/queue/scheduling.mdx): Cron scheduling with human-readable helpers, timezone support and pattern validation
- [Validation](apps/docs/content/docs/queue/validation.mdx): Automatic Zod validation of queue configuration, job options, names and job data
